cohort: 367 babies born between January 1, 2013, and December 31, 2020, conceived following sibling oocyte randomization to SCS or ICSI in normo-responsive women
finding: There was no significant difference in perinatal outcomes between singleton and twin babies born after SCS and ICSI.
mod_finding: There was no difference in perinatal outcomes, including cesarean section rates, between babies conceived via simplified IVF culture system (SCS) and intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI).
